使用帮助Support

使用中遇到任何问题或有想法，欢迎直接联系我们。遇到异常时，附上你的设备、App 版本（在“我的 → 关于”里）和操作步骤，能帮我们更快解决。 Have a question or suggestion? Reach out anytime. If something misbehaves, telling us your device, version (in Me → About), and what you tapped helps us fix it quickly.

常见问题Frequently asked questions

语阅收费吗？Is Yuyue free?+

完全免费。没有广告，不用注册账号，也没有会员订阅。

Yes—completely free. No ads, no account, and no subscription.

我的书和笔记存在哪？Where are my books and notes?+

全部存在你自己的设备上。打开同步后，只在你的设备和你自己选的网盘（iCloud 云盘或私人网盘，Google Drive 即将支持）之间传输，开发者看不到也收不到。

On your own device. When you turn on sync, they travel only between your devices and your chosen iCloud Drive or personal cloud drive (Google Drive coming soon).

能打开哪些电子书和音频？Which books and audio files can I open?+

支持 EPUB、TXT、PDF 和无加密的 MOBI / AZW3 电子书，M4B、MP3 等有声书与长音频，播客 RSS / OPML 订阅，以及语阅整库备份快照（.yuyue）。

EPUB, TXT, PDF, and DRM-free MOBI / AZW3 books, M4B or MP3 audiobooks, podcast RSS / OPML feeds, and Yuyue library snapshots (.yuyue).

Mac 首次打开提示无法验证开发者怎么办？macOS blocked the first launch—what should I do?+

把「语阅」拖入「应用程序」并双击一次后，前往「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」，点一次「仍要打开」即可正常使用。详见 下载与安装指南。

Move Yuyue into Applications and open it once, then open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. See our Download Guide.

Windows 首次运行弹出 SmartScreen 保护提示怎么办？Windows Defender SmartScreen popped up—what should I do?+

因为语阅暂未购买商业代码签名证书，Windows 首次运行时会提示「已保护你的电脑」。点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」即可，装好后应用内更新均附带 SHA-256 校验。详见 Windows 安装说明。

Because Yuyue is not yet signed with a paid certificate, Windows may show “Windows protected your PC” once. Click More info → Run anyway; future in-app updates verify SHA-256 checksums automatically. See our Windows guide.

两台设备同时离线改了笔记，同步会覆盖吗？Will offline edits on two devices overwrite each other?+

不会。遇到冲突时，语阅会把两边的版本并排展示出来交给你决定，绝不暗中覆盖任何一条划线或想法。

Never. Conflicts appear side by side so you choose what to keep—nothing is silently overwritten.
